name: enterprise-as-code-artifact-reference
scope: Cross-repository logical artifact identity and bounded evidence binding. This is not a universal enterprise data model or network resolver.

syntax.local_id: one or more non-empty percent-encoded path segments; producer-defined

evidence_binding.rule: A logical reference becomes positive assurance only through a consumer contract that verifies the bound producer artifact according to that consumer's policy.

implemented_examples.meaning: Logical identity of one Reconciliation as Code run

current_consumers.behavior: Binds Reconciliation as Code run refs to verified local evidence registry entries before checkpoint assurance can pass.
Canonicalizes eac refs and materializes/relates explicitly supplied external artifacts; URI syntax alone does not establish assurance.

non_goals: automatic trust from a syntactically valid URI
replacement for producer-specific schemas and adapters
